about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Extended (formerly X10) tracking Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG), with pricing referencing Extended oracle (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Alphabet Inc. Class C share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Starknet.
